translationRepairs: Yue Ling Marquis Shi Gao, as maternal kin, headed Secretariat affairs; former General Xiao Wangzhi and Household Gentleman Zhou Kan served as his deputies.
Marquis of Yueling Shi Gao, as maternal kin, headed Secretariat affairs; General of the Vanguard Xiao Wangzhi and Grandee of Splendid Prosperity Zhou Kan served as his deputies.
樂陵侯 is the Marquis of Yueling; 前將軍 is General of the Vanguard; 光祿大夫 is Grandee of Splendid Prosperity.
Peng came out and proclaimed: "I told of five small faults and one great crime of the former general."
Peng came out and proclaimed: "I told of five small faults and one great crime of the General of the Vanguard."
前將軍 is a title (General of the Vanguard), not 'former general'.
Thereupon an edict to Chancellor and Censor: "Former general Wangzhi tutored Us eight years without other fault.
Thereupon an edict to Chancellor and Censor: "General of the Vanguard Wangzhi tutored Us eight years without other fault.
前將軍 is the title General of the Vanguard.
The matter is long past and memory hard to clear—pardon Wangzhi's crime and take back the seals of Former General and Household Gentleman;
The matter is long past and memory hard to clear—pardon Wangzhi's crime and take back the seals of General of the Vanguard and Superintendent of the Palace;
前將軍 is General of the Vanguard; 光祿勳 is Superintendent of the Palace.
In summer, the fourth month, on the last day yiyi, Maoling's White Crane Lodge burned;
In summer, the fourth month, on the last day, yiwei, Maoling's White Crane Lodge burned;
乙未 is the cyclical day yiwei.
In spring, the first month, he made the Lord of Zhouzi South Marquis of Zhou, Heir of Rest.
In spring, the first month, he made Lord Zinan of Zhou the Marquis of Zhou Chengxiu.
周子南君 is Lord Zinan of Zhou; 周承休侯 is the marquisate of Zhou Chengxiu.
In the sixth month, on day xinyou, Chief Steward for Eternal Faith Gong Yu became censor-in-chief.
In the sixth month, on day xinyou, Lesser Treasurer of the Changxin Palace Gong Yu became censor-in-chief.
長信少府 is the Lesser Treasurer of the Changxin Palace.
On day dingsi, Chief Steward for Eternal Faith Xue Guangde became censor-in-chief.
On day dingsi, Lesser Treasurer of the Changxin Palace Xue Guangde became censor-in-chief.
長信少府 is the Lesser Treasurer of the Changxin Palace.
In winter, the twelfth month, on day dingmo, Gong Yu died.
In winter, the twelfth month, on day dingwei, Gong Yu died.
丁末 is a graphic error for the cyclical day 丁未, dingwei.

In the second month, an edict: "The chancellor and censor are to recommend men who are plain, sincere, humble, yielding, and of good conduct; the Director of the Masters of Writing each year is to rank palace gentlemen and attendants by this standard."

In the second month, an edict: "The chancellor and censor are to recommend men who are plain, sincere, humble, yielding, and of good conduct; the Superintendent of the Palace each year is to rank palace gentlemen and attendants by this standard."
光祿 here is the Superintendent of the Palace (光祿勳).
The vanguard Director of the Masters of Writing Zhang Meng advanced and said, "Your subject has heard that when the ruler is sage, ministers are upright.
The vanguard Grandee of Splendid Prosperity Zhang Meng advanced and said, "Your subject has heard that when the ruler is sage, ministers are upright.
光祿大夫 is Grandee of Splendid Prosperity.
Chancellor -{Yu Dingguo}-, Grand Marshal and General of Chariots and Cavalry Shi Gao, and Censor-in-Chief Xue Guangde all resigned on account of prodigies and anomalies.
Chancellor Yu Dingguo, Grand Marshal and General of Chariots and Cavalry Shi Gao, and Censor-in-Chief Xue Guangde all resigned on account of prodigies and anomalies.

Director of Convict Labor Zhuge Feng of Langye was at first famed at court for his uncompromising integrity; he repeatedly clashed with powerful families, and those in office often spoke of his faults.

Metropolitan Superintendent Zhuge Feng of Langye was at first famed at court for his uncompromising integrity; he repeatedly clashed with powerful families, and those in office often spoke of his faults.
司隸校尉 is the Metropolitan Superintendent.
When Feng was Director of Convict Labor he ignored the seasons, revised laws and standards, and relied on harsh cruelty to win empty prestige;
When Feng was Metropolitan Superintendent he ignored the seasons, revised laws and standards, and relied on harsh cruelty to win empty prestige;
司隸校尉 is the Metropolitan Superintendent.
